Using Class Ability while within 15 meters of an enemy grants Super Energy.

Reduced effectiveness in PVP, exact values are currently unknown.

Class Ability Usage while within 15 metres of an enemy grants Super Ability Energy.

Super Energy Gains with 1|2+ Mods:
<pve 2.5% /> <pvp [1.25%] /> | <pve 4% /> <pvp [2.4%] />

Energy Multipliers based on Class:
<hunter/>Hunters: x1 | <titan/>Titans: x1.2 | <warlock/>Warlocks: x2
